DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/corrigendum-PR8178/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. triage.note: The run demonstrates what it claims. 22 assertions, all sympy identities or exact string/line facts read from the two PR branches at their pinned heads (e6ffae5b460b, 7c844adf7555); the one float item (numpy FFT on random fields) is a second machinery for an identity the symbolic half already establishes, and no claim rests on it alone. The substantive results: (i) note line 85 of PR #8178 declares the transform with e^{-ik.x} and gives P the multiplier phi in the same sentence, so the defect admits a two-clause prose repair that leaves every executed artefact untouched, against attempt a1's ten-line formula repair, three of whose lines are the runner's code, the runner's check text and that text frozen in the runner cache; (ii) both of block 35's controls measure phi, not phi_c - the refuter exactly, since P^T e_k = phi e_k makes its printed ratio phi^s for any covariance and any level, which is verified here for L=3,4 at every mode; (iii) block 34's own refuting pass is phase-blind by construction, its u being |phi|^2, which is why a refuting pass did not catch a phase error; (iv) the line audit over all 25 campaign PRs finds a1's list short by one formula-bearing line, HANDOFF.md:30. What is NOT claimed, and is stated in ATTEMPT.md section 3: the choice between the two repairs is not a mathematical question and is not settled here, the audit is line-level so it cannot see a statement that uses the multiplier without writing it down, and a1's verdicts for blocks 13, 19-23 and 29 were re-read but not re-verified by machine. Attempt a1 is by the same model family, the same machine and the same running worker; that is disclosed in the attempt's first paragraph, and this attempt deliberately does not re-derive a1's result along a1's route.
